description: Searches, file reads, exploring a codebase or folder, status reads
check: the answer cites the file, line or source it came from

description: Tests, benchmarks, measurements, builds: code runs them, a model only reads the result line
check: the result line is quoted exactly

description: One yes/no or pick-one call: classify, triage, gate a tool call, route a task
check: agreement with a labeled sample

description: Labeling, extraction, summaries over many items (use a provider's batch route if it has one)
check: spot check of a random sample against labels

description: Plans, research reports, comparing options, reading many sources
check: every claim graded and sourced; a reviewer finds no missing option the brief named

description: The plan, scaffold and acceptance checks written before any code job starts
check: each step names its file and its check; the build that follows passes them

description: A routine change in known files
check: tests, type check and lint pass

description: Multi-file change, hard bug, unfamiliar code, long autonomous run
check: tests pass, including a new test that failed before the change

description: Reviewing a change; one rung above the model that wrote it
check: finds the seeded bugs in a review trial set

description: Reading a failure, log or red check and naming the cause
check: the named cause, once fixed, turns the check green

description: Questions over data: the model writes the query or script, code computes every number
check: numbers reproduce when the script is rerun

description: Docs, notes, messages, copy, translation
check: a reviewer rubric or a style lint passes

description: Anything published under someone's name: site copy, release notes, listings
check: reviewed by a higher rung before it ships

description: Making pictures: concept art, views, textures. A picture tool does it; a model writes the prompt pack
check: the picture check row passes against the references

description: Looking at pictures: render against reference, screenshot diagnostics, flaw lists
check: agreement with a person's own marks on past pictures

description: Motion, keyframes, rigs, shaders, particle and visual effects code
check: frames rendered and passed by the image-check row

description: Scripted 3D work: modeling, sculpt or clay passes, retopology, detail levels, skeleton fit
check: measured counts plus a render passed by the image-check row

description: Sound, music, voice and video making: a media tool does it; a model writes the brief
check: a listening or viewing rubric

description: Driving a browser or desktop: playtests, form filling, checking a page as a user sees it
check: the observable end state is read back

description: Status, handoffs, keeping several agents or threads in step
check: nothing owed is dropped in a sampled handoff

description: Answering a person directly: questions, support, explanations
check: a rubric on sampled answers

description: Grading a trial; must be a different model from the one under test
check: agreement with code checks; a person rules where they differ
